title: Fix disallowed origin CORS errors in the canvas editor

requirements.text: In the canvas-based customization editor (EditorPage.tsx) and any component that embeds or communicates with an iframe or postMessage-based draft editor, add the application origin 'https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz' to the list of allowed origins. Ensure all postMessage calls and any origin-checking logic explicitly allow this origin so that 'disallowed origin' errors are eliminated.
acceptanceCriteria: No 'draft-editor:error disallowed origin' messages appear in the browser console when the editor page is loaded at https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz.
The canvas customization editor loads and functions correctly (image upload, drag, zoom, rotation) without being blocked by origin checks.
postMessage communication between the editor and any parent frame (or vice versa) succeeds without origin errors.
The fix applies to all pages/components that trigger the disallowed origin error, not just a single file.

requirements.text: Audit the entire frontend codebase for any hardcoded origin whitelist arrays, window.addEventListener('message', ...) handlers with origin checks, or Content-Security-Policy meta tags that restrict frame/script sources. Update all such locations to include 'https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz' as a permitted origin, and remove any wildcard or overly restrictive origin filters that would block the deployed Caffeine preview domain.
acceptanceCriteria: All origin whitelist arrays in the frontend include 'https://sole-aqua-rc6-draft.caffeine.xyz'.
No Content-Security-Policy meta tag in index.html blocks scripts, frames, or connect-src from the Caffeine preview domain.
Any message event listeners that reject unknown origins are updated to permit the Caffeine preview domain.
The application runs without CORS or origin-related console errors on the preview deployment.

constraints: Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths (useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
Do not alter backend CORS settings in main.mo — this is a frontend-only origin configuration fix.
nonGoals: Adding new editor features or modifying editor functionality beyond fixing the origin error.
Changing the visual design or layout of any page.
